teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never, habit, frequency, everyday, week, month

elements.content: always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never, habit, frequency, everyday, week, month

• I always drink coffee in the morning (100% frequency)
• I usually go to work by bus (80% frequency)
• I sometimes cook dinner (50% frequency)
• I never wake up late on Monday (0% frequency)
7 days a week, 100% of the time you drink tea. Which word describes this?

A: Do you always have breakfast at home?
B: No, I usually have breakfast at home, but sometimes I buy coffee on my way to work.
A: Do you ever wake up late?
B: Never during the week!
Listen to a lifestyle survey about daily habits and complete the frequency ratings.

teacherNotes.title: Multi-Duration Strategy
teacherNotes.content: Choose 60m, 90m, or 120m flow based on scheduled class length.

elements.content:
• 60m Flow (Essential): 0-10m Warm-up & Goal; 10-25m Vocab & Chunks; 25-40m Grammar Practice; 40-55m Speaking Pair Task; 55-60m Cool-down.
• 90m Flow (Expanded): 0-10m Warm-up; 10-30m 5-step Vocab Drills; 30-50m Grammar Workshop; 50-70m Roleplay; 70-85m Writing; 85-90m Wrap-up.
• 120m Flow (Full Workshop): 0-15m Icebreaker; 15-40m Vocab Lab; 40-70m Grammar Simulation; 70-100m Group Activity; 100-115m Writing Portfolio; 115-120m Reflection.
